title: Violent Night 2
overview: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

title: Arnie & Barney
overview: A platoon of ants set out to save their community in the midst of a severe drought, but the hilariously inept Arnie and Barney – who are not cut out for heroics – decide to tackle the problem themselves. Their bumbling efforts lead them to uncover a shady water racket and team up with a secretive superhero mosquito. In a series of comical mishaps, they inadvertently save the meadow and become the most unlikely heroes of all.

title: Behemoth!
overview: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

title: Maricones
overview: Since they were little, Ginger and Louie knew they were different. Two young Queers who, living in different spaces, face social prejudices that try to limit their way of being. This tension confronts them with their identity process and leads them to question the need for external validation. Thus, they decide to use fashion and their bodies as a tool to express and build their identity as a process of constant fluidity, free and without labels.

title: Dune: Part Three
overview: Emperor Paul Atreides faces the fallout from his ascent to power as political plots and a galaxy-wide holy war endanger the future only he can see.
